_comment: Ground truth for grading Friction runs against this site. Not imported by the app.

bugs.description: Clicking "Add to cart" with no size selected does nothing: no error, no shake, no disabled state.
bugs.expectedFix: Show inline feedback (e.g. highlight the size fieldset and/or show an error) when Add to cart is clicked with no size chosen, instead of returning silently.

bugs.description: The promo code "Apply" button's click handler attaches behind a 1.2s setTimeout, so a click before then is silently swallowed and shoppers click twice.
bugs.expectedFix: Attach the click handler synchronously instead of deferring it behind a timer.

bugs.description: Sold-out sizes render as ordinary selectable radios with no visual indication; the shopper only learns a size is unavailable from the error banner after submitting.
bugs.expectedFix: Disable the radio input and add a "Sold out" label for any size in product.soldOutSizes.

bugs.description: This one product page awaits an artificial 5.6s delay before responding, simulating an unoptimized backend call made only for this item.
bugs.expectedFix: Remove the per-item delay (or make whatever it stands in for asynchronous/parallel) so the page responds like every other product page.

bugs.description: A signup popup opens unprompted on a 2.5s timer on every product page.
bugs.expectedFix: Don't open the modal automatically; trigger it from explicit user intent (e.g. a visible "Get 10% off" link) or remove the timer.

bugs.description: The newsletter modal never receives focus on open and swallows Tab entirely; only Escape closes it, so keyboard users can get stuck.
bugs.expectedFix: Move focus into the dialog on open, implement a real focus trap that cycles Tab between the dialog's own focusable elements, and restore focus to the trigger on close.

bugs.description: Every product card's button reads "Select options" with no product name attached, so the accessible name is identical across the whole grid.
bugs.expectedFix: Give the button an accessible name that includes the product, e.g. aria-label={`Select options for ${product.name}`}.

bugs.description: hasLimitedStock()/isFullyOutOfStock() already know which sizes are gone, but ProductCard never renders that, so shoppers open the product page to find out a size is sold out, then go back and try another.
bugs.expectedFix: Render a small "Limited sizes" or "Almost gone" flag on the card when hasLimitedStock(product) is true, using data already available in lib/inventory.ts.

bugs.description: Checkout has six screens where three would do: shipping-confirm and payment-confirm each just echo the previous form back behind a second "Confirm" click.
bugs.expectedFix: Remove the two standalone confirm screens; fold their summaries into the bottom of shipping.astro and payment.astro respectively, and update CHECKOUT_STEPS accordingly.
